## Description

Combines classic Equal Risk Contribution (ERC) portfolio optimization with distribution-free conformal prediction intervals to bound maximum portfolio tail loss probability under non-stationary distributions.

## Where it may fit

Macroeconomic transition periods, volatile regime shifts, strict tail-risk-constrained institutional mandates.

## Vehicles

Risk parity funds, institutional endowment allocators, multi-asset pension funds.

## Required data

Historical asset return vectors, out-of-sample calibration loss residuals, asset covariance matrices.

## Caveats

Requires adaptive non-stationary conformal extensions (e.g. Adaptive Conformal Inference) to handle financial distribution drift.
